title: Sparkly train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sparkGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff7a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffcf3d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles around train -->
  <g fill='#ffe873'>
    <path d='M12 22 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z'/>
    <path d='M86 18 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6z'/>
    <path d='M80 62 l1.8 4.4 4.4 1.8 -4.4 1.8 -1.8 4.4 -1.8 -4.4 -4.4 -1.8 4.4 -1.8z'/>
    <path d='M20 70 l1.4 3.6 3.6 1.4 -3.6 1.4 -1.4 3.6 -1.4 -3.6 -3.6 -1.4 3.6 -1.4z'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='12' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='8' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='44' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='50' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- track -->
  <rect x='6' y='80' width='88' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5c3e'/>
  <g fill='#b08a5e'>
    <rect x='12' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='30' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='48' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='66' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='84' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <g fill='#3f6fb0' stroke='#8fb8ef' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='77' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='77' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='77' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#cfe3ff'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='77' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='77' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='77' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- engine body -->
  <rect x='22' y='42' width='52' height='32' rx='4' fill='#e8483f'/>
  <rect x='22' y='42' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff8a7a'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='58' y='26' width='18' height='20' rx='3' fill='#2f9e8f'/>
  <rect x='61' y='30' width='12' height='9' rx='2' fill='#c8f6ef'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='28' y='28' width='8' height='16' rx='2' fill='#3a4a63'/>
  <rect x='25' y='24' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#6f86a8'/>
  <!-- boiler front -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='7' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <!-- stripe -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='52' height='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- steam puffs -->
  <g fill='#bfe9ff' opacity='0.95'>
    <circle cx='32' cy='16' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='10' r='4'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='16' r='3.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
